# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository contains a multi-module GitHub Copilot engineering workshop built with Slidev.

The repository is presentation-oriented, but the workshop itself is engineering-focused and workflow-oriented.

## Primary Goals

- Teach AI-assisted software engineering workflows
- Teach GitHub Copilot beyond autocomplete
- Explain AI-ready repositories, instructions, agents, MCPs and Spec Driven Development
- Maintain engineering rigor and operational realism
- Prioritize practical workflows over feature catalogs

## Presentation Style

- Prefer one strong idea per slide
- Avoid overloaded slides
- Prefer progressive disclosure
- Prefer diagrams and workflows over bullet walls
- Use concise technical language
- Avoid marketing tone
- Avoid exaggerated AI claims

## Workshop Positioning

The workshop progression is:

1. Individual productivity
2. Team behavioral shaping
3. AI-ready repositories
4. Orchestration and MCP
5. Spec-driven development
6. AI-SDLC

## Layout System

Use the layouts and visual language from:
- pages/subscription-efficiency/
- subscription-efficiency.md

as the canonical design reference.

Do not introduce inconsistent layout styles.

## Engineering Mindset

Prioritize:
- validation
- reproducibility
- workflow quality
- architectural reasoning
- operational thinking

Avoid:
- feature dumping
- command catalogs
- generic AI hype
- shallow prompting tips

## Workshop Constraints

The audience may include:
- beginners
- advanced users
- architects
- tech leads
- legacy developers
- mixed-stack teams (.NET, React, COBOL, Power Builder, etc.)

Examples should remain broadly understandable and not overly framework-specific unless required.
